QuestScriptDef.label: Quest: The Sword of Kahless
QuestScriptDef.description: Tales speak of the legendary Sword of Kahless, lost long ago. A contact claims to know where it is hidden and will reveal the location in exchange for a small favor. If the story is true, securing the sword would greatly inspire any Klingon followers.

li.label: The Sword of Kahless
li.text:
A Klingon talespinner has given you a lead on the legendary Sword of Kahless. After a series of coded messages and honor-duels by proxy, the contact finally reveals the supposed location.

 To your surprise, the sword is not being contested – it has been forgotten here, far from Qo'noS. For now.

 Bringing the sword into your house will ignite the spirit of Kahless in any true Klingon under your command.
